page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via KVM virtualization. The system is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. It features 80 dedicated vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per vCPU. Network connectivity is delivered via a 25 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

The hardware configuration includes no local storage drives and zero GPU devices. Data persistence depends entirely on network-attached storage services. Because system resources concentrate memory capacity relative to compute cores, this instance offers positive qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads by reducing the total host instance footprint required to host large datasets.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is designed for memory-intensive enterprise tasks. Primary workload fits include in-memory databases, large relational database buffer caches, real-time data analytics, enterprise software deployments, and memory-bound ETL data processing pipelines.
